note: Quotes are copied from the official pages listed in source_url. Status 'verified' means the text was read from that page on as_of. Status 'unverified' means it could not be read and no value is stated.

rows.requirement: Site must clearly and prominently state the Associate disclosure.
rows.quote: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
rows.site_action: Shown in the footer of every page and beside the product links.

rows.section: FTC Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers
rows.requirement: Disclosure must be placed with the endorsement message, hard to miss, in simple, clear language.
rows.quote: The disclosure should be placed with the endorsement message itself.
rows.site_action: Each product table row has a note directly above it that says these are affiliate links.

rows.section: FTC Endorsement Guides: What People Are Asking
rows.requirement: Endorsements must be honest and not misleading; material connections should be disclosed clearly and conspicuously.
rows.quote: The Guides, at their core, reflect the basic truth-in-advertising principle that endorsements must be honest and not misleading.
rows.site_action: Site copy is limited to facts read from the listing title. No product test or personal experience is claimed.

rows.requirement: Prices may appear on the site only if Amazon serves the link that shows them, or if the price came from the Creators API or PA API.
rows.quote: your Site may only show prices and availability if: (a) we serve the link in which that price and availability data are displayed, or (b) you obtain Product pricing and availability data via Creators API or PA API
rows.site_action: No prices are shown. The price column is blank and flagged.

rows.requirement: Each Special Link must include the Associates ID (tag) as a URL parameter.
rows.quote: you must include your Associates ID or “tag” (appearing as XXXXX-##, or such other format as we may designate) as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site.
rows.site_action: FLAGGED. The resolved product links for all 3 products contain no tag parameter. The Associates ID was not provided, so none was added. See flagged item F-06.

rows.requirement: No inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive, or misleading claims about any Product.
rows.quote: You must not make inaccurate, overbroad, deceptive or otherwise misleading claims about any Product, an Amazon Site, or any of our policies, promotions, or prices.
rows.site_action: Specs on the site come only from the listing title. Nothing else is claimed.

rows.requirement: Third-party materials must carry significant commentary, analysis, or transformation.
rows.quote: Original content utilizing third-party materials must contain significant commentary, analysis, or transformation to any materials you include.
rows.site_action: Each product has original comparison and analysis text. Amazon descriptions and images are not copied.

rows.requirement: When linking to pages with Product lists, the site must have additional original content relevant to the link.
rows.quote: When linking to pages with Product lists you must have additional original content on your Site that is relevant to the Special Link.
rows.site_action: The category page includes original comparison and analysis text above the product table.

rows.topic: Program Content must not be altered
rows.requirement: Program Content may not be added to, deleted from, or otherwise altered, except for permitted resizing or truncation.
rows.quote: You will not add to, delete from, or otherwise alter any Program Content in any way
rows.site_action: FLAGGED (F-07). Product titles on the site are copied from Amazon listing pages. Whether titles count as Program Content is not confirmed.

rows.requirement: Purchases referred through a link that sends users to Amazon through an intermediate site without any click by the customer are disqualified.
rows.quote: any Product purchased by a customer who is referred to an Amazon Site by a link that sends users indirectly to an Amazon Site via an intermediate site, without requiring the customer to click on a link or take some other affirmative action on that intermediate site
rows.site_action: No auto-redirects. Every product link is a plain click.

rows.requirement: Purchases referred by ads bought on keywords containing Amazon trademarks are disqualified.
rows.quote: any Product purchased by a customer who is referred to an Amazon Site through any advertisement that you purchased, including through participation in bidding or auctions on keywords, search terms, or other identifiers that include the word “amazon”
rows.site_action: No paid ads are run. Do not buy ads on Amazon terms.

rows.requirement: Site domain, subdomain, tag, or username may not include an Amazon trademark or misspelling.
rows.quote: include any trademark of Amazon or its affiliates, or a variant or misspelling of a trademark of Amazon or its affiliates in any domain name, subdomain name
rows.site_action: Site host is kanlerxz87-cyber.github.io/Zone1. No Amazon mark is used in the host name.

rows.requirement: The site must accurately disclose cookies, pixels, and data collection, including by third parties.
rows.quote: disclosing on your Site accurately and adequately and otherwise satisfying applicable legal requirements ... the use of cookies, pixels, and other technologies by you and third parties
rows.site_action: The site adds no analytics or cookies of its own. Amazon's own pages may set cookies. A privacy note is on the Sources page. Legal review is needed (F-10).

rows.requirement: Standard commission is a percentage of Qualifying Revenue, set by the rate schedule in the Appendix.
rows.quote: we will pay you standard commission income described in the Appendix
rows.site_action: UNVERIFIED (F-08). The schedule URL redirects to an Amazon sign-in page. No rate is entered for any product.

rows.requirement: Must be enrolled in Associates, have at least 10 qualifying sales in the past 30 days, register for API access, and generate credentials.
rows.quote: Have at least 10 qualifying sales within the past 30 days to access the PA API through the Creators API
rows.site_action: Automated price or review pulls are not built. No credentials exist (F-09).

rows.section: Creators API Documentation: PA-API 5 Deprecation Notice
rows.requirement: PA-API 5 is deprecated and replaced by the Creators API. Calls to PA-API 5 return 403 AccessDenied.
rows.quote: The Amazon Product Advertising API 5.0 (PA-API 5) has been deprecated and is being replaced by the Creators API.
rows.site_action: Any future automation must use the Creators API, not PA-API 5.

rows.topic: Operating agreement: Associate may not imply affiliation
rows.requirement: Associate must not misrepresent or imply any affiliation or endorsement by Amazon.
rows.quote: You will not misrepresent or embellish our relationship with you (including by expressing or implying that we support, sponsor, or endorse you)
rows.site_action: The site does not use Amazon logos. It says it is not affiliated with Amazon.
